comparison.objective: Assemble a three-gear train by seating three gears on their shafts with adjacent teeth meshed.
comparison.physical_skill: Shaft insertion, vertical seating, and tooth-phase discovery through contact for two gear meshes.
comparison.success_condition: Correct gears are fully seated on their assigned shafts, both adjacent pairs mesh, gears are still, and arms are clear.
comparison.reason: Tests contact-guided tooth phasing and multi-part insertion; it lacks impact, intentional breakage, retained-component damage constraints, and fragment containment.
